simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בִּיתָן (H1055) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בִּיתָן (bîythân) means a palace (i.e. large house) First listed occurrence: Esth 1 5.

definitions.full: H1055. bithan בִּיתָן noun [masculine] house, palace — absolute הַבִּיתָן Est 7:7-8 , ( הב ׳גִּנַּת ); construct בִּיתַן 1:5 ( ב ׳גִּנַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ ), all garden of ׳בּ ; according to Dieulafoy RŠJ 1888, cclxxvii. throne-room , synonym of apadâna in meaning, but compare אַמֶּדֶן . בֵּית preposition between , see [ בַּיִן ] below בין .
